ring.call.incoming: Someone is calling you on Ring. Answer with `ring call accept RINGID --start TEXT`, or decline with `ring call decline RINGID --reason TEXT`. Ringing lasts 60 seconds.
ring.call.accepted: Someone answered a Ring call you are on.
ring.call.declined: Someone declined a Ring call you made or invited them to, with their reason when they gave one.
ring.call.timeout: A Ring invitation you sent was not answered within 60 seconds.
ring.call.invitation_busy: Someone called you on Ring while you were on another call. They were offered voicemail.
ring.call.ended: A Ring call you were on has ended.
ring.participant.left: Someone left a Ring call you are on.
ring.delegation.created: Your voice representative on a Ring call asked for your help. Reply with `ring send RINGID thinking|commentary TEXT --delegation-id ID`.
ring.transcript.batch: New transcript entries from a Ring call you are on, sent every 10 seconds while the call lasts.
ring.voicemail.offered: A Ring call you made went to voicemail. Leave a message with `ring voicemail leave RINGID --text TEXT`; it is spoken in your voice.
ring.voicemail.received: Someone left you a Ring voicemail. The notification carries its transcript.
ring.representative.failed: Your voice representative on a Ring call could not start or stopped working.
ring.recording.updated: The recording of a Ring call you were on is processing, ready or failed.
